notes.title: Bugfixes and balancing
notes.notes:
🐞 Bugfixes:
It was no longer possible to build walls

Enemy units sometimes appeared red at the start of a battle and stayed that way

Clay pits could no longer snap together

Fire mage projectiles simply disappeared when placed on walls

If the player was still in the building menu when a battle started, the buttons remained visible

When sending a merchant to a resource, the button didn’t disappear. Pressing it again caused an error

When trying to move a building, the rest of the UI remained active

If a building was completed while the player was under attack, it appeared in the overworld after the next load instead of in the village
⚖️ Balancing:
AI now “thinks” significantly slower, giving the player more time overall

Defense bonus of walls and towers has been increased

The number of peasants spawned per skill point increased from 1 to 3

Merchant movement speed has been doubled

Peasants are now slightly more durable

Fire mages now deal less damage to buildings

AIs can now only send armies every few minutes — a random interval between 3 and 6 minutes

notes.title: Small improvements and bugfixes
notes.notes:
🛠️ Improvements:
It's now easier to select units placed on walls

Placing units on walls has been slightly improved

The castle icon will now wiggle while the player is under attack


🐞 Bugfixes:
After units took damage, not all colors were correctly reset

When a wall or tower was destroyed during combat and a unit was standing on it, the unit now dies instead of floating

Fire mages were unable to recognize towers as buildings

When moving a wall with a unit on top, the unit would remain floating in the air


⚖️ Balancing:
AI opponents can now only have one attack army at a time to prevent overwhelming the player in the endgame

AIs now use fewer archers during attacks

All melee units are now more durable

notes.title: Info buttons and bug fixes
notes.notes:
🛠️ Improvements:
Tooltips are now available for all buildings and all units.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44371533/7eb3d26a98dd602f85cb09f68f65de1223688054.png"]

The easiest difficulty level has been made slightly easier.
🐞 Bug Fixes:
It was possible to speed up game time by repeatedly pressing Pause and Play.

Villagers no longer drop into negative numbers when popularity is low.

It was not possible to place multiple clay pits next to each other, even though it appeared to be allowed.

If food rations were set to -5 and the game was reloaded, they were reset to 0.

notes.title: Bugfixes and balancing
notes.notes:
🛠️ Bug Fixes:
In castle view, if no path was available, units could no longer be placed during an attack.

Units were made narrower to better fit through tight corridors.

Workers are now teleported back to the storage after a while if they have no path.

If a trade was canceled, the button wasn’t hidden, and pressing it again caused an error.

If a merchant returned to the castle after a canceled trade, they were counted twice for the player.

It was possible to need a negative amount of merchants which then got added to the players merchants.

If the skill UI was still open while being attacked, it remained open and allowed unintended actions 🙂

Armies and merchants could no longer find the player's city after loading the game.

Lowering the sound slider to halfway made the audio so quiet it was barely audible (this may affect existing settings).

Workers should no longer stand in front of the storage and do their working animation after loading

After pausing and unpausing the game was running faster in the background
⚖️ Balancing Changes:
Merchants now costs 35 gold instead of 100.

The market now costs 100 gold instead of 200.

Stables now require 10 less wood and stone.

Walls and towers now provide significantly more defense bonus to units stationed on them.

Bakers now require more wheat but produce more bread per work cycle.
Other changes:
The quarríes will now be placed further appart from each other by default

notes.title: Bug fixes and small improvements
notes.notes:
🔧 Adjustments:
The cost of the church has been reduced

Buttons for recruiting units and accessing the skill tree are now also available in the castle view

Mages now deal less damage to buildings

A sound effect now plays when research is completed
🐞 Bug Fixes in the Last Two Versions:
Win and Lose screen buttons were not working

A crash occurred when an army had a negative player index

There was a ghost town with a negative player index

Workers sometimes got so heavily congested at the storage area that they couldn’t move away

Occasionally, skill configurations failed to load correctly, resetting everything back to zero

Thanks to Kekskiller for reporting these issues :)

notes.title: The new demo will release very soon!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!



At the beginning of the year, I decided to completely reprogram the game to optimize the code and rework the core gameplay.

Over time, I grew dissatisfied with the old system, so I changed it entirely.

The game is now a fast-paced real-time strategy experience with the same mechanics as before, but significantly more performant and stable.

This makes future updates easier and faster to develop.

I’ve also tried to make the code as mod-friendly as possible, so that mods can be easily supported later on.

I’m not ready to announce an exact release date yet, as I’m still in the testing phase — but if you’d like to help out by hunting bugs, feel free to reach out and join in!

I’m excited to release the demo soon!

Best regards, Maikel – GamingPugsStudios
